_info.description: Safety buffer for BESS discharge - prevents deep discharge
_info.example: If min=20 kWh, max=180 kWh, threshold=0.20: safety_level = 20 + (160 × 0.20) = 52 kWh

effects.higher_threshold: More protection, less utilization, longer battery life
effects.lower_threshold: Less protection, more utilization, shorter battery life

_info.warning: Values below 0.15 (15%) are NOT recommended for production use!
how_to_change: 2. Choose from 'recommended_values' or use custom value
